product.name: Monoprice Blackbird 1080P Video Extender with HDMI over Coaxial Cable up to 100m
product.description: Blackbird™              1080p Video Extender with HDMI® Over Coaxial Cable Up to 100m              Extend High‑Definition HDMI Video Up to 100 Meters Over 75‑Ohm Coaxial Cable                  Transform your audiovisual experience with the Blackbird 1080p Video Extender by Monoprice™. Designed for reliability and superior performance, this innovative device transmits crisp, high‑definition HDMI signals up to an impressive 328 feet (100 meters) using a single RG‑6 coaxial cable. This means you can often utilize pre‑existing coaxial infrastructure in homes or commercial spaces, simplifying installation and reducing the need for costly new wiring. Whether you're setting up a home theater, a dynamic conference room, or a vibrant public display, the Blackbird extender ensures your content travels the distance‑without sacrificing quality.Engineered with cutting‑edge technology, the Blackbird extender supports video resolutions up to 1080p@60Hz and delivers a robust video bandwidth of 6.75Gbps, ensuring stunning visuals with rich, vibrant colors. With Deep Color support up to 36 bits and impeccable digital audio fidelity at a 48‑kHz LPCM sampling rate, every detail is faithfully reproduced for a truly immersive viewing and listening experience. HDCP™ 1.1 compliance secures your content, making it ideal for both professional and entertainment environments.Installation is seamless and hassle‑free: simply connect your HDMI devices with the transmitter and receiver units, and enjoy secure, equalized, and restored TMDS® data transmission. The package comes complete with everything you need, including two AC power adapters, mounting ears, and a user manual for quick and easy setup. Built for durability and versatility, the Blackbird extender operates smoothly within a wide temperature and humidity range, ensuring reliable performance in any environment.Step into the future of HDMI connectivity‑choose the Blackbird 1080p Video Extender by Monoprice and experience AV freedom without limits.
